analysis_type: Exploratory follow-up after observing a near-zero held-out denominator; not preregistered and not independent validation
trigger: The completed local-identifiability diagnostic found a minimum absolute held-out denominator of 0.00039998906362274933 in fold 1

method.parameter_rule: Reuse every frozen fold parameter vector; no refitting or parameter adjustment
method.root_rule: Numerically solve D(x)=1+b5*x+b6*x^2+b7*x^3 with numpy.roots using coefficient order b7,b6,b5,1
method.real_root_rule: Absolute imaginary part below 1e-8, matching the earlier Hahn1 denominator audit convention
method.root_checks: Report numerator, denominator residual and denominator derivative at every numerical real root; locate roots relative to held-out ranges and nearest training observations
method.scope: Numerical root localization only, not an exact algebraic proof or a certified global pole analysis

prohibitions: No cancellation assumption when numerator and denominator both vanish
No use of the certified full-fit denominator proof as evidence about different fold-specific coefficients
No reversal of fold 1 failure and no new model selection
